title: Bed generation & status tracking
description: Auto-generate the right number of beds for a room based on its type, and track each bed's VACANT/OCCUPIED status independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a DOUBLE room creates exactly 2 beds, TRIPLE creates 3
Bed status flips correctly on tenant onboarding/checkout

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - bed auto-generation wired into room creation only (not on later type edits; changing a room's type after beds/tenants exist is a reconciliation problem this ticket's AC doesn't cover, flagging rather than guessing). AC2's flip mechanism (BedRepository.setOccupied/setVacant) is this ticket's job per its own wording, but the actual callers are LODGY-13 (onboarding) and LODGY-14 (checkout) - building the mechanism now, wiring the calls when those land.

AC1 done and build-verified: RoomFormViewModel.save() now calls bedRepository.generateForRoom(room.id, bedCountFor(type)) right after creating a room (1/2/3 beds for SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE), and a new BedGridScreen (matching the wireframe) shows each room's beds with VACANT/OCCUPIED status, wired from RoomListScreen's onOpenBeds. AC2's mechanism (BedRepository.setOccupied/setVacant) exists but has no caller yet - deliberately leaving this ticket in In Progress rather than Testing, since 'the flip works on onboarding/checkout' can't honestly be claimed ready for test until LODGY-13/14 actually call it. Will move to Testing once those land and the flip can be exercised end to end. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL in the meantime.
